note: Structure mirrors e2e-neutral-streaming/thresholds.json (same metric definitions). Values are PROVISIONAL starting points taken from the neutral control set validated at RTX 4070 Ti scale; every tolerance must be re-frozen from the official two-stream gold run before judging any round. The two-stream case is NOT neutral: drift decay and E^2 growth are expected physics, so the neutral ceilings below are placeholders, not physical expectations.

particle_count_conservation.definition: Macro-particle count per species must not change between first and last particle snapshot.

ux_drift_relative_max.definition: Weight-averaged streaming four-velocity ux per drifting species vs the initialized drift magnitude (0.2 c) over the WHOLE run.
ux_drift_relative_max.formula: max over every particle snapshot of abs(mean_ux(t) - 0.2) / 0.2 <= tolerance
ux_drift_relative_max.note: two-stream instability thermalizes the drift: whether this is a ceiling or a growth band is a gold-run decision

min_particles_per_species.definition: Enough macro-particles per species are sampled at the last particle snapshot for the ux statistic to be meaningful.
min_particles_per_species.formula: min over species of N_sp_sampled(t_last) >= tolerance

b1_mean_absolute_deviation.definition: Domain-averaged B1 stays at the imposed background (zero for the unmagnetized two-stream).
b1_mean_absolute_deviation.formula: abs(mean(B1)(t) - 0.0) <= tolerance for every field snapshot

b1_squared_relative_drift.definition: Magnetic energy proxy <B1^2> stays at its (near-zero) initial level for the unmagnetized case.
b1_squared_relative_drift.formula: max over stats rows of <B1^2> <= ceiling

e_squared_noise_ceiling.definition: Electric energy: for the neutral control this was a noise ceiling; for two-stream it is the instability GROWTH channel.
e_squared_noise_ceiling.formula: max over stats rows of (<E1^2> + <E2^2> + <E3^2>) — band to be frozen from the gold run
e_squared_noise_ceiling.note: placeholder copies the neutral ceiling; the gold run must replace it with the expected growth band

energy_relative_drift.definition: Total energy (T00 / stats total) conserved within discretization error.
energy_relative_drift.formula: abs(E_tot(t) - E_tot(t0)) / E_tot(t0) <= tolerance for every stats row

stats_time_monotonic.definition: Stats time column strictly increases and contains no NaN/Inf (output sanity).
